common.no_lyrics: No lyrics found for this song.
common.no_usable_lyrics: No usable lyrics found from provider.

typography.title: Typography
typography.desc: Adjust font settings and text size for lyrics.

font_family.label: Font Family
font_family.hint: The font used for all lyrics.

active_line_size.label: Active Line Size
active_line_size.hint: Size of the currently sung line — should be larger than text size.

active_font_weight.label: Active Font Weight
active_font_weight.hint: Thickness of the active line. 600–700 is usually most readable.

font_style.label: Font Style
font_style.hint: Style of the lyrics (normal or italic).

layout.title: Layout
layout.desc: Widget dimensions and number of lines shown simultaneously.

visible_lines.label: Visible Lines
visible_lines.hint: Number of lines visible at once (best as an odd number).

widget_width.label: Widget Width
widget_width.hint: The width of the floating lyrics widget.

border_radius.label: Border Radius
border_radius.hint: The corner roundness of the widget.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.desc: Effects, transparency, and movement of lyrics.

inactive_opacity.label: Inactive Opacity
inactive_opacity.hint: Opacity of non-active lines. Lower values make the active line stand out.

background_opacity.label: Background Opacity
background_opacity.hint: Opacity of the widget background. 100% is fully opaque.

glide_duration.label: Glide Duration
glide_duration.hint: Time taken to transition between lines. Higher = smoother but slower.

hide_on_pip.label: Hide Widget on PiP
hide_on_pip.hint: Hide the floating widget when PiP is open.

background_mode.label: PiP Background Mode
background_mode.hint: Choose the background style for the PiP window.

dominant_color.label: Thumbnail Theme
dominant_color.hint: Use dominant colors from thumbnail as PiP theme.

thumbnail_bg.label: Thumbnail Background
thumbnail_bg.hint: Show video thumbnail as PiP background.

video_bg.label: Video Background
video_bg.hint: Show live video as PiP background (may consume more resources).

language.title: Language
language.desc: Select the display language for the app.
language.label: Display Language
language.hint: Interface language for controls and settings.
